legend: JATC loves Banh-mi (a Vietnamese food). His affection for Banh-mi is so much that he always has it for breakfast. This morning, as usual, he buys a Banh-mi and decides to enjoy it in a special way.

First, he splits the Banh-mi into n$$$n$$$ parts, places them on a row and numbers them from 1$$$1$$$ through n$$$n$$$. For each part i$$$i$$$, he defines the deliciousness of the part as xi∈{0,1}$$$x_i \in \{0, 1\}$$$. JATC's going to eat those parts one by one. At each step, he chooses arbitrary remaining part and eats it. Suppose that part is the i$$$i$$$-th part then his enjoyment of the Banh-mi will increase by xi$$$x_i$$$ and the deliciousness of all the remaining parts will also increase by xi$$$x_i$$$. The initial enjoyment of JATC is equal to 0$$$0$$$.

For example, suppose the deliciousness of 3$$$3$$$ parts are [0,1,0]$$$[0, 1, 0]$$$. If JATC eats the second part then his enjoyment will become 1$$$1$$$ and the deliciousness of remaining parts will become [1,_,1]$$$[1, \_, 1]$$$. Next, if he eats the first part then his enjoyment will become 2$$$2$$$ and the remaining parts will become [_,_,2]$$$[\_, \_, 2]$$$. After eating the last part, JATC's enjoyment will become 4$$$4$$$.

However, JATC doesn't want to eat all the parts but to save some for later. He gives you q$$$q$$$ queries, each of them consisting of two integers li$$$l_i$$$ and ri$$$r_i$$$. For each query, you have to let him know what is the maximum enjoyment he can get if he eats all the parts with indices in the range [li,ri]$$$[l_i, r_i]$$$ in some order.
All the queries are independent of each other. Since the answer to the query could be very large, print it modulo 109+7$$$10^9+7$$$.
input: The first line contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and q$$$q$$$ (1≤n,q≤100000$$$1 \le n, q \le 100\,000$$$).
The second line contains a string of n$$$n$$$ characters, each character is either '0' or '1'. The i$$$i$$$-th character defines the deliciousness of the i$$$i$$$-th part.
Each of the following q$$$q$$$ lines contains two integers li$$$l_i$$$ and ri$$$r_i$$$ (1≤li≤ri≤n$$$1 \le l_i \le r_i \le n$$$) — the segment of the corresponding query.
output: Print q$$$q$$$ lines, where i$$$i$$$-th of them contains a single integer — the answer to the i$$$i$$$-th query modulo 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$.
note: For query 1$$$1$$$: One of the best ways for JATC to eats those parts is in this order: 1$$$1$$$, 4$$$4$$$, 3$$$3$$$, 2$$$2$$$.
For query 2$$$2$$$: Both 3$$$3$$$, 4$$$4$$$ and 4$$$4$$$, 3$$$3$$$ ordering give the same answer.
In the second example, any order of eating parts leads to the same answer.

legend.ai: JATC 喜欢 Banh-mi（一种越南食物）。他非常喜爱 Banh-mi，因此总是把它当作早餐。今天早上，他像往常一样买了一个 Banh-mi，并决定用一种特别的方式享用它。

首先，他将 Banh-mi 分成 n$$$n$$$ 份，将它们排成一列，并从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$ 编号。对于每一份 i$$$i$$$，他将该份的美味度定义为 xi∈{0,1}$$$x_i \in \{0, 1\}$$$。JATC 将依次吃掉这些部分。在每一步中，他会任意选择一份尚未被吃掉的部分并将其吃掉。假设该部分是第 i$$$i$$$ 份，那么他的 Banh-mi 愉悦度将增加 xi$$$x_i$$$，并且所有剩余部分的美味度也将增加 xi$$$x_i$$$。JATC 初始的愉悦度为 0$$$0$$$。

例如，假设 3$$$3$$$ 份的美味度为 [0,1,0]$$$[0, 1, 0]$$$。如果 JATC 吃掉第二份，那么他的愉悦度将变为 1$$$1$$$，剩余部分的美味度将变为 [1,_,1]$$$[1, \_, 1]$$$。接下来，如果他吃掉第一份，那么他的愉悦度将变为 2$$$2$$$，剩余部分将变为 [_,_,2]$$$[\_, \_, 2]$$$。吃掉最后一份后，JATC 的愉悦度将变为 4$$$4$$$。
然而，JATC 不想吃掉所有部分，而是想留一些以后再吃。他给你 q$$$q$$$ 个查询，每个查询由两个整数 li$$$l_i$$$ 和 ri$$$r_i$$$ 组成。对于每个查询，你需要告诉他：如果他以某种顺序吃掉下标位于区间 [li,ri]$$$[l_i, r_i]$$$ 内的所有部分，他能够获得的最大愉悦度是多少。
所有查询彼此独立。由于查询的答案可能非常大，请输出答案对 109+7$$$10^9+7$$$ 取模的结果。

input.ai: 第二行包含一个长度为 n$$$n$$$ 的字符串，其中每个字符都为 '0' 或 '1'。第 i$$$i$$$ 个字符定义了第 i$$$i$$$ 份的美味度。
以下 q$$$q$$$ 行中的每行包含两个整数 li$$$l_i$$$ 和 ri$$$r_i$$$(1≤li≤ri≤n$$$1 \le l_i \le r_i \le n$$$)，表示对应查询的区间。

output.ai: 输出 q$$$q$$$ 行，其中第 i$$$i$$$ 行包含一个整数，即第 i$$$i$$$ 个查询的答案对 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$ 取模后的结果。

note.ai: 在第二个样例中，以任意顺序吃掉这些部分都会得到相同的答案。
